purpose: Incremental information in microstructure after a volume trigger; match hard negatives on same coin, not quiet ordinary observations
upstream: Frozen minute_onset volume cutoff exp(0.8338692277262161), unchanged event5min+2% and60min+8%, same36coins and quality gates. No new retrospective pump definition.
sampling: Use all upstream eligible volume-trigger timestamps. Case=earliest trigger5..60min before each objective onset, one per event. Retrospective case anchoring, NOT prospective precision. Controls same coin/same split, no onset in0..60min and next60min peak<8%, at least24h from case, within14calendar days, circular time-of-day within4h. Match volume logratio,log7dayvolatility,logliquidity,log1p(candidate burst age), with discovery-only SD, maxdistance3;3 controls on distinctUTC days. A burst continues if successive volume-trigger timestamps are <=10min apart. No fine-feature based matching or replacement after raw quality check.
raw_windows: Read original public spot trades in [anchor-60min,anchor). No trade at/after anchor. Stable timestamp order; all RPI included. Quality: raw quote total matches cached5min total within1%, both past15 and baseline45min >=80% active1min bins; lasttrade within60sec; one-minute returns begin with first observed trade price (no future filling). Drop entire4-row set on any shared quality failure.

features.buy_persistence: Fraction active1min bins netbuy>0 in last15min minus baseline45min fraction
features.buy_acceleration: Net buy notional fraction last5min minus previous10min
features.sell_resilience: Baseline45min downside return per sell imbalance minus recent15min same value; only1min netbuy<=-0.20; >=6 baseline and>=3 recent sell-heavy minutes; unavailable otherwise
features.price_efficiency: Last15min compounded return / sum(abs one-minute returns), higher=more orderly upward path
features.arrival_acceleration: log(median positive unique-timestamp gap baseline45min / last5min), min10 gaps each; ignores simultaneous timestamp batching
features.large_buy_change: Buy quote notional from individual prints above baseline45min95th-percentile quote / total quote; recent15min minus baseline45min

discovery: Apr2..Jun30 with120min label purge beforeJul1. Direction inferred only here. At most2 candidate features with >=10 complete matched sets, oriented concordance>=0.60 and95%7day-block lower>0.50. No forced selection. Source and directions frozen before later fine-feature comparisons.
replication: Aug1..Sep30. Same inferred directions and definitions;99.1667%7day-block bootstrap intervals for6 features,10000 draws. Missing feature excludes whole set for that feature. Period already inspected on other features; exploratory temporal replication, not fresh confirmation.
scope: Matched microstructure analysis estimates conditional differences, not signal precision, ROC on the full universe, or causal order-book absorption. No claims about whales, passive orders, or profit. Preserve earlier frozen forward experiment.
